title: Prometheus + Grafana Compose stack (real-derived from docker/awesome-compose)

source.notes: Base = the upstream (valid) prometheus-grafana compose.yaml. Three defects injected: a host-port collision, a config-path/mount mismatch, and a dangling named volume. Image and container_name lines are untouched.

construction.proposer: opus-4.8 (proposed); audited & confirmed 2026-07-05 via oracle audit (validator + anchor-resolution + real/findable/unique pass, docs/oracle-audit-2026-07-05.md) with a targeted human audit of ambiguous/interacting defects and all gray zones (docs/human-audit-checklist)

clean_regions.note: prometheus image and container_name are upstream and valid
grafana image and container_name are upstream and valid

known_gray_zone.note: The top-level volume `prom_data` is left unused once d3 renames the mount; declared-but-unused, not a seeded defect.
GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD is a hardcoded weak password (upstream, untouched). A reviewer may flag it as a security smell; not a seeded defect, so exclude from false-finding scoring.
